feeding_claim.verbatim: They spend their days grazing and moving through pasture rather than being confined or grain-finished.

notes: Single-page site with about, ordering, our cattle and contact sections; the separate Buy.html page returned an error. Herd raised on pasture in Gorham on an all-grass diet, pasture in season and hay in winter, and the site says the cattle are not grain-finished. Orders by email to sebagolakeranch@gmail.com from a price list, invoiced, with pickup by appointment and a 100 dollar minimum. Sells quarter, half and whole animals plus cuts when available. No phone, street address, delivery or shipping listed. Feeding quote came from a WebFetch summary.
